subject: session: track LastCommitTS in SessionVars and check timestamps of later txns are larger (#57305)
summary: Adds `SessionVars.LastCommitTS` and records the last successful txn commit TS; enforces monotonic session ordering by rejecting new transactions whose `StartTS` is older than the session’s last commit TS (skipping snapshot/preset-TS cases). Extends `kv.Transaction` with `CommitTS()` and adds a failpoint-backed regression test to simulate a future commit TS and validate the guard.
